1. WORKS: Contractor will provide the works set forth in this Agreement, including any exhibits and schedules attached hereto, and incorporated herein by this reference, which constitutes such agreement of the parties (collectively, the “Agreement”) and the services requested by the Company hereunder and customarily provided by Contractors performing the same role in similar productions, for the acting reel project currently named {{nombreProyecto}} (“Picture”). For clarity, Contractor’s services for the Picture shall be provided in accordance with the Company’s schedule and instructions, Contractor’s services shall include all pre-production, production, and post- production services requested by the Company and customarily provided by Contractors performing the same role in similar productions, in Exhibit A attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Works”). The terms and conditions of this Agreement apply to all Works that are commissioned by Company during the Term, regardless of whether any such Works are completed or required to be completed prior to expiration or earlier termination of the Term.

 

 

 

 

2. RIGHTS:

 

1) The Contractor accepts and acknowledges that the Company and its subsidiaries, successors, assigns, and licensees shall have the exclusive right and ownership of all results and products of the Contractor’s Services at any stage of development, and that the Company’s exclusive rights include, without limitation, copyright and related rights, the right of reproduction, the right of adaptation, the right of translation, the right of dubbing and subtitling, the right of exhibition, the right of promotion, the right of public communication, the right of distribution, the right to create derivative works, and the right to rent and/or license the Work, free and clear of any lien, claim, and/or encumbrance. Without limiting the foregoing, the Contractor accepts and acknowledges that, in the future, new rights over the Work may arise or be recognized under applicable laws and/or any legal system (the “New Exploitation Rights”), and hereby grants, assigns, and transfers to the Company each and all such New Exploitation Rights in and to the Work, worldwide and for an unlimited term.

2) Contractor hereby grants to Company the irrevocable rights to use its name, voice, approved image, approved likeness and/or approved biography in perpetuity (to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law and for the maximum legal term of protection, if shorter) throughout the universe in all media and modes of distribution in connection with the Picture and the distribution, exploitation, advertising and/or promotion thereof (including commercial tie-ins and the exploitation of any ancillary rights related to the Picture).

 

3) In addition, and notwithstanding the above provisions, Company grants Contractor a license to use the Picture created under this Agreement solely for the promotion of the Contractor and/or its principals and for demonstration purposes in connection with the public promotion and/or advertising of Contractor.

 

3.TERM:

1) This Agreement shall be effective for the period commencing on Parties’ execution of this Agreement and will continue in effect until acceptance and approval (which shall not be unreasonably withheld) by Company of all the Deliverable Items described in Exhibit A (“Term”) unless sooner terminated as provided herein.
2) Any additional work must be separately negotiated for in good faith. Company shall not be liable for payment for any such additional work performed until it has executed a separate agreement for such work in writing.

4. CONTRACTOR RESPONSIBILITIES: With respect to each Work commissioned during the Term, Contractor shall:

1) Deliver each Work to Company on a timely basis in the formats and on or via the media, and to the address, set forth in Exhibit A, or as otherwise specified by Company when the Work is commissioned;

2) Prior to delivery of each Work, obtain from all persons who are, or whose property is, identified, depicted, or otherwise referred to in such Work, such written and signed licenses, permissions, waivers, and consents (collectively, “Permissions” and each, individually, a “Permission”), including those relating to publicity and privacy, as are or reasonably may be expected to be necessary for Company, including its licensees, successors, and assigned, to exercise its rights in such Work, including all intellectual property rights therein, without incurring any payment or other obligation to, or otherwise violating any right of, any such person.

 

 

5. FEES:

1) If Contractor is not in material breach of this Agreement, subject to any other applicable terms and conditions, Contractor shall receive the remuneration specified in Exhibit A;

2) Payment will be made in pursuant to the date set forth in Exhibit A in accordance with the Company’s standard payment policy for the Picture (unless otherwise specified therein): (i) after Company’s timely receipt of a Work that complies with this Agreement; or (ii) prorated to the days worked in the case of a Work that is incomplete due to any reason.

 

6. CREDIT: Company shall accord credit to Contractor 1) on screen; 2) in paid advertisements and in other materials, Project Manual, Press Kits for the Picture wherever the writer(s), director(s), and/or producer(s) of the Picture are accorded credit as mutually agreed upon through email.

 

7. TERMINATION: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause on thirty (30) days’ written notice to the other party. In the event of termination pursuant to this clause, Company shall pay Contractor on a pro-rata basis any Fees then due and payable for any Works or portions of Works completed up to the date of such termination, provided, however, Contractor shows proof of compliance with Section 8.

 

8. EXIT OBLIGATIONS. Upon (i) termination of this Agreement or (ii) at Company’s request at any time during the Term, Contractor shall (a) provide or return to Company any and all Works or portions of Works and all documents and materials related thereto and stored in any fashion, that are in the possession or control of Contractor; and (b) delete or destroy all copies of any such Works or portions of Works and materials not returned to Company that remain in the Contractor’s possession or control, including those stored on any personal devices, networks, storage locations, and media. Contractor shall send Company a written certificate evidencing compliance with this Section 7 as soon as reasonably possible after the provision or destruction of Works or portions of Works and their related documents and materials.

 



9. REPRESENTATIONS/WARRANTIES; INDEMNIFICATION:

1) Contractor represents and warrants that (i) the Materials are original (other than materials provided to Contractor by Company or any items in the public domain of which Contractor notifies Company), will not infringe or violate the rights (including any copyright) of, and will not defame, any person or entity, and are not subject to any claim, lien or interest of any third party; (ii) Contractor will comply with all (A) Applicable laws, rules, and regulations, and (B) reasonable Company policies, requirements, and guidelines/manuals of which Contractor has become aware; and (iii) Contractor is capable and fully entitled to enter into and perform under this Agreement. Contractor shall indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its assignees, licensees and each of its affiliates from and against any and all losses, liabilities, damages, expenses and/or costs (“Losses”) arising out of any third-party claims in connection with Contractor’s breach or alleged breach of any of its agreements, representations or warranties under this Agreement and/or Contractor’s negligence or willful misconduct.

 

2) Company represents and warrants that Company is capable and fully entitles to enter into and perform under this Agreement. Company shall indemnify, defend and hold Contractor harmless from and against any Losses arising out of any third-party claims in connection with Company’s breach or alleged breach of any of its agreements, representations or warranties under this Agreement and the production, distribution and exploitation of the Picture by the Company or its affiliates, except for any Losses for which Contractor is required to indemnify the Company under this Agreement.

 

10. NON-DISCLOSURE, CONFIDENTIALITY AND PROPRIETARY AGREEMENT:

1) The term “Confidential Information” means any information or material which is proprietary to the Company or Company’s assignee, whether or not owned or developed by the Company or Company’s assignee, which is not generally known other than by the Company or Company’s assignee, and which the Contractor may obtain through any direct or indirect contact with the Company or Company’s assignee. Regardless of whether specifically identified as confidential or proprietary, Confidential Information shall include any information provided by the Company or Company’s assignee concerning the Picture and the production of the Picture and any third party with which the Company or Company’s assignee deals, including, without limitation, business records and plans, trade secrets, financial information, pricing structure, discounts, contracts, copyrights and intellectual property.

 

 

2) The term “Proprietary Information” means information or material a) Proprietary to the Company or Company’s assignee or b) designated as confidential by the Company or Company’s assignee or 3) not known generally to the public which the Contractor may obtain through any direct or indirect contact with the Company or Company’s assignee. The Proprietary Information includes without limitation the following types of information and other information of a similar nature (whether tangible or intangible and whether or not reduced to a writing): any and all information relating to the Picture and its production and exploitation, including without limitation any and all information relating to the short screenplay and treatment, feature screenplay and treatment, budget, schedule, plans, drawings, designs, specifications, ideas, concepts, models, costumes, techniques or special effects for the Picture or other creative, business and/or physical production elements relating to the Picture.


3) Contractor understands that it is an essential term of such engagement that Confidential/ Proprietary Information be maintained in the strictest confidence. Accordingly, Contractor agrees that unless and until Contractor is expressly authorized to do so by the Company or its authorized representative(s) in writing, Contractor shall: a) Keep all Confidential/Proprietary Information (whether relating to Contractor’s services or otherwise learned by Contractor) in strictest confidence; b) Not reproduce or duplicate any Confidential/Proprietary Information (unless required to render services and then only the minimum so required); c) Return any Confidential/ Proprietary Information in Contractor’s possession (and erase any Confidential/Proprietary Information duplicated to Contractor’s hard drive or digitally stored and provide certification of such actions) upon request therefore by the Company; d) Not disclose, report, reveal, gossip or speculate about, assign, sell or transfer, either directly or indirectly, by any means including without limitation by email, blogging, Instagram or tweeting, any Confidential/Proprietary Information to any person or company with the exception of other persons performing services on the Picture, but then only if and to the extent necessary in order for them to perform such services or evaluate a possible transaction (collectively, “Authorized Personnel”), subject to informing such Authorized Personnel of the confidentiality requirements with respect to the Confidential/ Proprietary Information and arranging for their prior signature of a copy of this Agreement.




11. PRINCIPAL PHOTOGRAPHY CLAUSES:

1) No expenditures above the budget approved in writing by Company will be made or authorized by Contractor without prior approval of the Company or its representatives. All purchases and rentals must be authorized by approved Purchase Orders prior to transaction. In addition, Contractor shall not have the right to hire, upgrade, or promote other Contractors or employees without prior written approval of the Line Producer or Producer, and execution of a separate crew deal memo setting forth the terms of such agreement.

 

2) All petty cash expenditures must be pre-approved by Producer and documented by valid original receipts and must be submitted for reimbursement within five (5) days of expenditure. In the event Contractor drives an automobile on behalf of the production, traffic and parking tickets issued to Contractor shall be paid for by Contractor, and such costs shall not be reimbursed by Company. If unpaid traffic or parking violations are reported after Contractor has concluded services on the Picture, Contractor shall be responsible for all fines, late fees, and/or processing fees in connection with such tickets.

 


3) No additional services or overtime shall be paid without the prior written approval of Producer. Contractor shall not be paid for holidays and idle days not worked. Time reports must reflect hours actually worked and be submitted before the time designated by the Line Producer.

4) Contractor acknowledges that the Works contemplated to be rendered by Contractor are not subject to any guild or union collective bargaining agreement. Accordingly, without limiting the general of the foregoing, Contractor agrees that in no event will Contractor be entitled to any payment for any use or reuse of the Picture or any part thereof and/or any rights therein.

5) The agreed remuneration to Contractor will be paid by ACH/Direct Deposit and subject to applicable tax withholdings, if any.
 

6) Contractor agrees that any personal vehicle used in connection with Contractor’s Works will be used under Contractor’s direction and control. Contractor is solely responsible for any damage to or loss of such vehicle and hereby waives any claims against the Company for any loss or damage of any kind. Company shall have no obligation to indemnify Contractor against any losses or damages, or to provide any insurance coverage for the benefit of Contractor covering the vehicle herein described. Contractor understands that prior to driving, Contractor is required to have a valid driver’s license and carry at least a third-party liability insurance. Contractor must have, if applicable, a current insurance for the term of the Agreement, which covers any type of damage, loss, accident and/or theft of its material and/or work tools.

 

7) The Company will have production insurance against accidents, civil liability, among others. Consequently, in the event that the material and/or tools are not covered by the insurance policy issued by the Contractor, Company may respond, without being obliged to do so and provided that the insurance company accepts, to file the claim for the same, being limited only to the coverage of the policy contracted by the Company. If, after investigation, that the parties determined that the Contractor is at fault for the loss, damage, accident and/or theft of its material and/or work tools, Contractor agrees to pay the deductible of said loss, damage, accident, and/or theft. Likewise, the Parties agree that in the event that the Contractor suffers an accident at any location or any other place of provision of the Work, not caused by the Contractor or by any of the other Contractors, Company will be responsible for paying the expenses caused, only up to the amount that the insurance policy issued allows and in accordance with the terms and conditions established in said insurance. Therefore, the Contractor, in this act releases the Company from any claim and/or liability that this may cause.

8) Contractor is prohibited from working for another production company during the hours set forth in Exhibit A. Any deviations require the prior written approval from Company. Violations of this policy will result in the termination of this Agreement.

 

9) Contractor acknowledges that Company has a strict policy prohibiting the use of alcohol or controlled substances during or immediately before work hours and that failure to adhere to this and other work rules could result in immediate termination of this Agreement.

10) The relationship between Company and Contractor shall be that of independent contractors and the Work shall be considered a “Work Made For Hire” and, consequently, under no circumstances shall Contractor be considered an employee of Company nor shall there exist a labor relationship between the Parties. Hence Contractor shall be solely responsible for its obligations related to the payment of income tax (except for the tax withholding made by Company), social security taxes, insurance premiums, retirement plan contributions and other similar obligations. Contractor will indemnify Company for any liability associated with Contractor’s failure to pay any required income tax (except for the tax withholding made by Company), social security taxes, insurance premiums, retirement plan contributions and other similar obligations. None of the provisions under this Agreement shall be construed as an association, partnership, representation or agency relationship between the Parties. Both parties hereby expressly acknowledge and agree that the Works under this Agreement are not subject to any regulation with a labor union and both parties agree to waive any rights and any legal action regarding all employer and employee relations.

 



12. MISCELLANEOUS:

1) ENFORCEMENT. The parties hereto agree that Company and its subsidiaries would be damaged irreparably in the event that any provision this Agreement were not performed in accordance with its terms or were otherwise breached and that money damages would be an inadequate remedy for any such nonperformance or breach. Accordingly, Company and its successors and permitted assigns shall be entitled, in addition to other rights and remedies existing in their favor, to an injunction or injunctions to prevent any breach or threatened breach of any of such provisions and to enforce such provisions specifically (without posting a bond or other security). Contractor agrees that Contractor will submit itself to the personal jurisdiction of the courts of the State of California in any action by Company to enforce an arbitration award against Contractor or to obtain interim injunctive or other relief pending an arbitration decision.

 

 



2) ARBITRATION. Contractor and Company agree to meet and confer in good faith to resolve any problems or disputes that may arise under this Agreement. Any controversy, dispute or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement or the breach thereof, including any question regarding its interpretation, existence, validity or termination, shall be resolved by arbitration in accordance with this Paragraph IX; provided, however, that the following shall not be subject to arbitration: a legal proceeding brought by a third party against Contractor or Company, or any crossclaim or third party claim brought by a third party against Contractor or Company. Negotiation shall be a condition precedent to the filing of any arbitration demand by either party, and no arbitration demand may be filed until the exhaustion of Company’s internal appeal procedures. In the event arbitration between Contractor and Company becomes necessary, such arbitration shall be initiated by either party making a written demand for arbitration on the other party. The arbitration shall be conducted in state courts located in the City and County of Los Angeles. The arbitration shall be conducted in accordance with the internal laws of the State of California without giving effect to any choice or conflict of law provision or rule. The parties expressly agree to be bound by the decision of the arbitrator(s). The parties further agree that the prevailing, or substantially prevailing, party’s costs of arbitration are to be borne in equal shares by the other party. Notwithstanding this agreement to arbitrate, Contractor or Company may seek interim and/or permanent injunctive relief pursuant to this Agreement in any state courts located in the city and County of Los Angeles of competent jurisdiction.

 

 

3) SEVER ABILITY. If any provision of this Agreement is found to be illegal, invalid, unconscionable, or unenforceable under present or future laws effective during the term hereof, such provision shall be fully severable. This Agreement is to be construed and enforced as if such illegal, invalid, unconscionable, or unenforceable provision had never comprised a part hereof. The remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect unaffected by such severance, provided that the invalid provision is not material to the overall purpose and operation of this Agreement.

 

 

4) ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This Agreement, together with the Work Orders, Exhibits and all other documents incorporated by reference, contains all the terms and conditions agreed upon by the parties hereto regarding the subject matter of this Agreement. Any prior or contemporaneous agreements, promises, negotiations or representations, either oral or written, relating to the subject matter of this Agreement not expressly set forth in this Agreement are of no force or effect. This Agreement shall take precedence over any other documents that may be in conflict therewith. Neither party shall be entitled to any benefits other than those specified herein. The parties acknowledge that in entering into and executing this Agreement, the parties rely solely upon the representations and agreements contained in this Agreement and no others. The parties acknowledge that they have sought and received whatever competent advice and counsel as was necessary for them to form a full and complete understanding of all rights and obligations herein and that the preparation of this Agreement has been their joint effort. The language agreed to expresses their mutual intent and the resulting document shall not, solely as a matter of judicial construction, be construed more severely against one of the parties than the other.

 

5) SUCCESSORS AND ASSIGNS. Neither party to this Agreement shall assign or transfer its rights, duties, or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party; provided, however, Company may assign this Agreement to an affiliated or related third party without the consent of Contractor. Other than as expressly provided by this Agreement, any attempted assignment, by operation of law or otherwise, shall be void and unenforceable. This Agreement shall inure to the benefit of and shall bind the successors and permitted assignees of the parties hereto. This Agreement and the rights, interests and benefits hereunder shall not be assigned or in any manner transferred by Contractor.


6) GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be construed and governed under the laws of the State of California. Any and all claims or actions that might arise in any way in connection with or out of this Agreement shall be brought only in the courts located in Los Angeles County, California, and the parties hereby expressly waive any objection they would otherwise have to venue or jurisdiction in said courts.


7) AMENDMENT. The provisions of this Agreement may be amended or waived only by the written agreement of Company and Contractor, and no course of conduct or failure or delay in enforcing the provisions of this Agreement shall affect the validity, binding effect or enforceability of this Agreement. However, amendments as determined by Company to be necessary to effect compliance with legislative, regulatory, or other legal authority do not require the consent of Contractor and shall be effective immediately upon Contractor’s receipt from Company of notice of amendment.


8) WAIVER. The waiver by either party of any breach of any provision of this Agreement or warranty representation herein set forth is not to be construed as a waiver of any subsequent breach of the same or any other provision. The failure to exercise any right hereunder shall not operate as a waiver of such right. All rights and remedies provided herein are cumulative.

 

9) COUNTERPARTS. This Agreement shall be executed by an authorized representative of each party and may be executed in multiple copies. Each copy shall be deemed an original, but all copies together shall constitute one and the same instrument.

1. TRABAJOS. Para mayor claridad, los servicios del Contratista para la Obra Audiovisual se prestarán de conformidad con el cronograma e instrucciones de la empresa. Dichos servicios incluirán todos los de preproducción, producción y posproducción requeridos por la empresa y que habitualmente prestan contratistas en funciones equivalentes, según se describe en el Anexo A, que se adjunta al presente e integra el Contrato (los “Trabajos”). Los términos y condiciones del presente Contrato se aplicarán a todos los Trabajos encargados por la empresa durante su vigencia, independientemente de que tales Trabajos se completen o deban completarse antes de la expiración o de la terminación anticipada del mismo.

2) El Contratista concede por la presente a la Empresa los derechos irrevocables de utilizar su nombre, voz, imagen aprobada, semejanza aprobada y/o biografía aprobada a perpetuidad (en la medida máxima permitida por la legislación aplicable y durante el plazo máximo de protección legal, si es más corto) en todo el universo, en todos los medios y modos de distribución relacionados con la Obra Audiovisual y la distribución, explotación, publicidad y/o promoción de la misma (incluidas las asociaciones comerciales y la explotación de cualquier derecho auxiliar relacionado con la Obra Audiovisual).

 

3) Además, y sin perjuicio de las disposiciones anteriores, la Empresa concede al Contratista una licencia para utilizar la Obra Audiovisual creada en virtud del presente Contrato únicamente para la promoción del Contratista y/o sus mandantes y con fines de demostración en relación con la promoción pública y/o la publicidad del Contratista.


3. PLAZO:

1) El presente Acuerdo entrará en vigor en el momento de su firma por las Partes y seguirá vigente hasta que la Empresa acepte y apruebe (sin demoras injustificadas) todos los Elementos Entregables descritos en el Anexo A («Plazo»), salvo que se rescinda antes de lo previsto en el presente documento.

2) Cualquier trabajo adicional deberá negociarse por separado de buena fe. La Empresa no será responsable del pago de ningún trabajo adicional realizado hasta que haya firmado un acuerdo por separado por escrito para dicho trabajo.

4. RESPONSABILIDADES DEL CONTRATISTA: Con respecto a cada Trabajo encargado durante el Plazo, el Contratista deberá:

1) Entregar cada Trabajo a la Empresa de manera oportuna en los formatos y en o a través de los medios, y a la dirección, establecidos en el Anexo A, o según lo especifique la Empresa cuando se encargue el Trabajo;

2) Antes de la entrega de cada Trabajo, obtener de todas las personas que estén identificadas, representadas o mencionadas de cualquier otra forma en dicho Trabajo, o cuyas propiedades lo estén, las licencias, permisos, renuncias y consentimientos por escrito y firmados (en conjunto, «Permisos» y, cada uno de ellos, individualmente, un «Permiso»), incluidos los relacionados con la publicidad y la privacidad, que sean o puedan ser razonablemente necesarios para que la Empresa, incluidos sus licenciatarios, sucesores y cesionarios, ejerzan sus derechos sobre dicho Trabajo, incluidos todos los derechos de propiedad intelectual sobre el mismo, sin incurrir en ningún pago u otra obligación hacia dichas personas, ni violar de otro modo ningún derecho de las mismas.
